fact: The Police crime statistics for January to December 2025 record 1,464 cyber criminal offences (illegal interception, computer-related fraud, publication of false information and others) against 1,281 in 2024, and list education on the amended Cybercrimes Act among the strategies against them.
title: Crime and Traffic Incidents Statistics Report, January - December 2025
publisher: National Bureau of Statistics, Tanzania Police Force
